> Questions for infra/legal:
> - Karthik: can we guarantee EU residency + KMS for this tenant? Any blockers for a UK IDTA scenario?

Short answers:
- Residency: Yes — we can pin customer routing to EU regions and prevent cross-region backups by configuration for Dedicated/Private customers; for Hosted customers we offer EU-only tenancy.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) in our EU regions. For Acme we can enable CMEK and confirm key ownership in the DPA.
- UK IDTA: No technical blocker. The main work is evidence and attestation for the TIA (data flows, subprocessors, country risk assessment).

Operational notes / fallback: If a regulator requires us to keep transactional processing strictly within the UK for certain services, we can stand up a UK-specific routing policy and a canary region. If legal/Acme prefer to avoid waiting on the UK Addendum, propose SCCs + enhanced contractual mitigations and a signed TIA attestation as an interim measure.

I can join the Acme call tomorrow at 14:00 BST if that helps.

— Karthik
